title: Geographic hierarchy (country > subdivision > city) + country alias normalization for all entity types
description: Step 1 of research/category-taxonomy-proposal.md (human decisions 2026-10-16: UI English only; proposal bands; geography for ALL entity types first). Today the graph has 937 flat region nodes (city, country and "City, FL" mixed), only 17 part_of edges (Florida roll-up only; "Key Largo, FL"-style names bypass it), country nodes exist only for United States/Spain/Monaco, and attrs.country on builder/designer/engine/shipyard has 77 raw spellings (USA/United States/UK/United Kingdom/UAE, compound values like "USA / Netherlands"). Build a new ingest retrofit hook ingest/src/mappers/regionHierarchy.js (same run-once pattern as regionCanonicalization.js, runs after it and before graphCleanup/export) that: (a) carries a data-driven table mapping each region slug to { country (ISO-3166 alpha-2 + canonical English name), subdivision (state/province/region, optional), city }; (b) normalizes country aliases in one shared COUNTRY_ALIASES table reused by every mapper that reads attrs.country; (c) mints canonical country and subdivision region nodes (attrs.level = 'country'|'subdivision'|'city', attrs.iso2 on countries) and emits part_of edges city -> subdivision -> country; (d) writes attrs.geo = { country_code, country, subdivision, city } onto every node with a located_in/based_in edge to a resolved region and onto builder/designer/engine/shipyard from their normalized attrs.country; (e) assigns a macro_region (North America, Caribbean, Mediterranean, Northern Europe, Middle East, Asia-Pacific, South America, Other) per country in the same table; (f) exports a meta.geo summary (counts per country/subdivision) in graph.json. Coverage target: every region with >= 3 inbound edges resolved by hand-curated table; the long tail may remain unresolved (attrs.geo absent) but never guessed. Ambiguous names (Portland, Newport, Henderson...) resolve ONLY via the existing corpus-scoped merge decisions in regionCanonicalization.js; nothing new is guessed. Never edit graph.json by hand; never mint cities from prose; preserve original attrs.country raw value as attrs.country_raw when it is rewritten. Update pinned baselines in ingest/tests/realCorpusExport.spec.js with dated comments. App: no UI change in this ticket beyond keeping 142 app tests green after the regenerated graph.json is synced to app/public/data/graph.json.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: ingest/src/mappers/regionHierarchy.js exists, is called from ingest.js after applyRegionCanonicalization and before applyGraphCleanup, is idempotent (second run changes nothing), and a clean `npm run ingest:clean` completes with no errors.

AC2: Every region node carries attrs.level in {country, subdivision, city} or attrs.level='unresolved'; country nodes carry attrs.iso2 (ISO-3166 alpha-2) and attrs.macro_region; no two country nodes share an iso2 (USA/United States/US collapse to one node, UK/United Kingdom to one, UAE/United Arab Emirates to one).

AC3: part_of edges form a tree: every city with a resolved subdivision has exactly one part_of to it, every subdivision has exactly one part_of to its country, no part_of cycles, and no part_of edge from a country node. All pre-existing Florida city -> region:florida roll-ups are preserved (region:florida becomes level=subdivision under US).

AC4: Coverage: 100% of region nodes with >= 3 inbound located_in/based_in edges are resolved (level != 'unresolved'); overall >= 70% of all 937 region nodes resolved; >= 90% of marina nodes, >= 90% of club nodes, >= 95% of shipyard nodes and >= 95% of builder nodes with a country attr carry attrs.geo.country_code. Numbers recorded in the hand-off with the measuring command.

AC5: COUNTRY_ALIASES normalization: attrs.country on builder/designer/engine/shipyard is rewritten to the canonical English name; the original raw string is preserved in attrs.country_raw whenever it differs; compound values ('USA / Netherlands', 'UK (founded in USA)') resolve to the FIRST named country with the raw preserved, and a pinned test locks at least 6 alias cases including one compound and one parenthetical.

AC6: Never-guess: ambiguous same-spelled cities not already decided in regionCanonicalization.js remain level='unresolved' with no attrs.geo; a test asserts at least two known ambiguous names (e.g. 'Newport', 'Portland' bare) are not assigned a country unless a corpus-scoped merge decision exists. Nothing new is minted from prose; node count delta equals exactly the number of new country+subdivision nodes minted (recorded in hand-off).

AC7: graph.json exports meta.geo = { countries: [{ iso2, name, macro_region, node_count }], subdivisions: [{ name, country_code, node_count }] } sorted by node_count desc; app/public/data/graph.json is byte-identical to ingest/data/graph.json; 142 app tests and full ingest suite (single-fork mode) green; pinned baselines in realCorpusExport.spec.js updated with dated comments.
AC8: Score guard: `npm run score` identifiable-only target metric does not DROP below 7.72 (it may rise); result recorded in the hand-off.

comments.author: orchestrator
comments.body:
PEDIDO ESTRUCTURADO (PLANTILLA-PEDIDO), completado por el orquestador a partir del pedido en prosa del humano ("necesito que los filtros mejoren... organizar la data para crear las categorías", 2026-10-16) y de sus decisiones del 2026-10-16: UI solo inglés; bandas de la propuesta; empezar por la geografía para TODAS las entidades.

1. Objetivo: que cada entidad del grafo tenga una ubicación jerárquica (país > subdivisión > ciudad) consultable, para que los filtros puedan ofrecer "todas las marinas de Estados Unidos" o "astilleros de Italia".
2. Actor: usuario final del sitio DataYacht (vía los filtros, pasos 4-6 del plan) y el pipeline de ingesta (que produce el dato).
3. Problema: 937 regiones planas, 17 aristas part_of (solo Florida), 77 grafías de país en attrs.country, países duplicados (USA/United States, UK/United Kingdom). Hoy no se puede filtrar por país.
4. Caminos y acciones esperadas:
   - Principal: ingesta limpia -> cada región resuelta recibe level/país/subdivisión; cada nodo enlazado recibe attrs.geo; graph.json exporta meta.geo.
   - Alternativo A: región ya decidida por regionCanonicalization (Portland OR, Henderson WA) -> hereda esa decisión.
   - Alternativo B: nodo con attrs.country en texto libre compuesto ("USA / Netherlands") -> primer país, raw preservado.
   - Alternativo C: región de cola larga sin entrada en la tabla -> level='unresolved', sin geo, sin inventar.
   - Fallo: nombre ambiguo sin decisión previa (Newport, Portland a secas) -> permanece unresolved; nunca se asigna país.
   - Fallo: segunda ejecución del hook -> no cambia nada (idempotencia).
5. Criterios de "hecho" del usuario: AC1-AC8 del ticket.
6. Restricciones: nunca editar graph.json a mano; nunca acuñar ciudades desde prosa; preservar attrs.country_raw; métrica identifiable-only no baja de 7.72; tests de ingest en modo single-fork; 142 tests de app verdes.
7. Fuera de alcance: facetas por tipo (paso 2), meta.facets (3), panel de facetas y UI (4-6). Van en tickets siguientes.

UC4 (valor compuesto): shipyard con attrs.country='USA / Netherlands'; esperar attrs.country='United States', country_raw='USA / Netherlands'.
UC5 (decisión previa heredada): region 'Portland, OR' (ya decidida en regionCanonicalization); esperar country_code='US', subdivision='Oregon'.

UC8 (árbol limpio): recorrer todas las aristas part_of; esperar 0 ciclos, 0 part_of saliendo de un país, cada ciudad resuelta con exactamente 1 part_of.
UC9 (idempotencia): ejecutar el hook dos veces sobre la misma DB; esperar conteo de nodos y aristas idéntico tras la segunda pasada.
UC10 (cobertura): medir con un script; esperar 100% de regiones con >=3 aristas entrantes resueltas, >=70% de regiones en total, >=90% marinas y clubes con geo, >=95% shipyards y builders con país.
UC11 (export): abrir graph.json; esperar meta.geo.countries ordenado por node_count desc, con iso2/name/macro_region, y app/public/data/graph.json byte-idéntico.
UC12 (no regresión): `npm run score` identifiable-only >= 7.72; suite ingest completa (single-fork) y 142 tests app verdes; nodos nuevos = solo países y subdivisiones (delta documentado).
